verdict.rationale: Warp documents a local user control to keep sensitive Blocks from being saved or to clear blocks from a machine. It also states that terminal input/output is never stored on its servers, and that Business/Enterprise plans get Zero Data Retention with admin-level privacy controls. Retention is mostly a fixed vendor or plan policy rather than a user-adjustable setting. Community complaints about data being sent to LLMs concern data flow, not retention, so they do not contradict these claims. Missing for 10: user-configurable retention periods for AI conversations and cloud agent run transcripts, documented deletion of server-side data such as Warp Drive objects, account and run history, ZDR available outside Business/Enterprise plans, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Sometimes, you may want to prevent a sensitive Block from being saved on your computer, or you may want to clear blocks from a machine entirely.
